items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: I was playing washboard playing drums and her singing. And recently I've been doing the same thing now with Cathy Chamberlain.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. I was playing washboard playing drums and her singing. And recently I've been doing the same thing now with Cathy Chamberlain. I've got a big book about that thick with all the pictures and all the names. I've got a big drum ...(?)... with an automobile on top of it.
I see... Well, okay... How did you get with Cathy Chamberlain, who a writer has called here "the queen of Rag-and-Roll"? How did you meet up with her and start playing?
